# NCTOH Workshop: Data Wrangling

This module demonstrates data import, cleaning, joining, and transformation for medical cohort datasets.

## Import and clean data

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(janitor)

df <- read_excel("community_trial_tob.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names()

head(df)
```

## Joining tables

```{r, eval=FALSE}
indi_hh <- indi |> 
  left_join(hh, by = "hh_id")

followup_all <- foll_0 |> 
  full_join(foll_3, by = "member_id", suffix = c("_0m", "_3m")) |>
  full_join(foll_6, by = "member_id", suffix = c("", "_6m"))
```

## Select helpers and safe column selection

```{r, eval=FALSE}
overall |> select(starts_with("sbp"))
overall |> select(ends_with("_0m"))
overall |> select(any_of(c("age", "sex")))
```

## Create new variables

```{r, eval=FALSE}
overall <- overall |> 
  mutate(
    tobacco_type = factor(tobacco_type, levels = c(0, 1, 2),
                          labels = c("None", "smoker", "chewer")),
    years_of_use = current_age - age_of_onset,
    pack_years = if_else(tobacco_type == "smoker",
                         (amount_per_day / 20) * years_of_use,
                         NA)
  )
```

## Reshape and summarize

```{r, eval=FALSE}
overall_long <- overall_age_u |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ft_0, ft_3, ft_6),
    names_to = "followup",
    values_to = "score"
  )

overall_age_u |> 
  group_by(wealth_quintile) |> 
  summarise(n = n(), mean_pack_years = mean(pack_years, na.rm = TRUE))
```

:::
